# Nomiswap DEX

> Nomiswap DEX is a non-custodial AMM on BNB Smart Chain for swapping BEP-20 tokens wallet-to-pool; its original team has disbanded.

## Key facts
- Type: AMM / DEX
- Networks: BNB Smart Chain mainnet (Chain ID 56)
- Custody: Non-custodial — your wallet signs
- Costs: Pool fee + network gas + price impact
- Token in/out: the pair you choose
- Verify: Check the pool and contract in the live app
